in_sanskrit.name: सुकृति
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: A virtuous deed, a meritorious act, good action, good work

in_marathi.name: Sukrti
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Well Deserved Merit
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sukrti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name of divine significance in Hinduism, Sukrti means 'well deserved merit' or 'earned by good actions'.

in_bengali.name: Sukrti
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Well Deserved Merit
in_bengali.long_meaning: Sukrti একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। A name of divine significance in Hinduism, Sukrti means 'well deserved merit' or 'earned by good actions'.
